markdown_report:
The next experiment remains a minimal lexical-residual HSTU, conditional on restoring executable training. This selection is provisional: simulation produced no observations, and quantitative diagnosis contains only a subprocess failure. No candidate satisfies the required evidence of addressing two observed user failures and one measured model failure; earlier inspirations cannot replace missing observations.

**Insights and directions.** Three starting-point insights remain: shared text parameters may transfer interaction supervision; tying history/candidate embeddings preserves representation consistency; zero-initialized residual scaling preserves baseline outputs initially. However, the zero gate initially blocks encoder task gradients, and activation is not guaranteed ([ReZero](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04887)).

Three literature insights refine the alternatives. [HSTU-BLaIR](https://kdd2025llm4ecommerce.github.io/assets/accepted/13_HSTU_BLaIR_Lightweight_Cont.pdf) supports content enrichment but uses prohibited pretrained representations. The [HSTU configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin) and [paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2402.17152v3) motivate objective and temporal experiments. [Character CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.06615) motivate ordered local text features; neither they nor unordered pooling establish compatibility or numerical understanding.

| Direction | Atomic experiment | Main uncertainty |
|---|---|---|
| Representation sharing | Scratch pooled-text residual | Permutation invariance; lexical/popularity shortcuts |
| Local composition | Whole-field character-CNN residual | Limited receptive field; additional compute |
| Ranking objective | Uniform sampled-softmax replacement | Temperature and negative-count calibration |
| Temporal context | Bucketed elapsed-time attention bias | Consistent inference timestamp availability |

**Candidate assessments.** Scores are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty, out of 10; unavailable alignment remains NA. Difficulty increases with complexity.

- **Lexical residual: 3/7/NA/NA/5.** Established fusion limits novelty; inexpensive sharing is promising. Localized implementation helps, but serialization and diagnostics require care.
- **Character CNN: 3/7/NA/NA/6.** Ordered substrings offer a useful extension; established convolutions limit novelty. Expressiveness increases alongside tuning and runtime costs.
- **Sampled softmax: 2/6/NA/NA/4.** Standard candidate competition is feasible; calibration and sampler errors constrain benefits.
- **Temporal bias: 3/6/NA/NA/6.** Existing HSTU machinery offers plausible recency modeling; timestamp routing complicates deployment.

**Provisional choice.** At 10% progress, retain pooling first; defer CNN, objective, and temporal changes. Prospective concerns are broad thematic matches, missed identifier/format distinctions, and incorrect positive–negative ordering. Pooling can distinguish retained identifiers but cannot encode phrase order or negation scope; none of these failures is established here.

Obtain the original exception before changing architecture. Preserve initialization, RNG state, baseline training, diagnostic interfaces, final-nonpadding readout, and checkpoint/predictor equivalence. Monitor gate activation and actual encoder gradients. Predeclare baseline, aligned-text, and budget-permitting matched-shuffle controls, each independently trained without prediction fusion. Fixed popularity/length/missingness-matched permutations test alignment beyond measured shortcuts ([TASTE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.14029)); they cannot prove semantic understanding.

Report pinned macro validation HR@10, category differences, frequency strata, and runtime. Bootstrap paired users only when exposed by the host; intervals exclude training variability and adaptive selection bias ([Dwork et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629)). Sampled rankings need not match full-catalog rankings ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)). Log every attempt and retain exploratory claims pending separate held-out evaluation.

idea.description: Provisional experiment: add a compact, jointly trained pooled-title/description residual to the corrected HSTU item embedding. Use the identical effective embedding for histories and candidate scoring, with exactly one trained checkpoint per category. Retain pooling as the initial controlled experiment; a whole-field character CNN is a subsequent alternative, not a simultaneous modification.
idea.motivation: At early research progress, a localized representation change offers a controlled test of interaction-supervised lexical sharing. It could address broad thematic matches and missed identifier or format distinctions, and reduce positive–negative ranking errors. These remain prospective hypotheses: user diagnosis contains no observations, and model diagnosis reports execution failure without measured behavior. No diagnosis-qualified best idea can currently be selected. Mean pooling distinguishes different retained token multisets, including identifiers and numbers, but cannot distinguish their order or establish compatibility, numerical relationships, negation scope, or current user need.
idea.implementation_notes:
Recovery and protocol: the corrected baseline source and underlying exception are absent, so this remains an integration specification rather than a reliable executable train.py patch. Obtain the actual training exception and restore executable baseline behavior before attributing failure to an architectural component. Do not infer the cause from CalledProcessError. Preserve DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, CDs_and_Vinyl and their routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, exactly 200 batches per completed epoch, single-GPU execution, supplied splits, optimizer, objective, batch size, clipping, validation schedule, checkpoint selection, and stopping behavior. Save artifacts beneath the trial directory; charge training, diagnostics, controls, debugging, and failures to the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. No test inspection, external data, pretrained weights, other-trial checkpoints, or evaluator changes.

Initialization: construct and initialize the entire corrected baseline first, in its original order. Initialize new modules inside torch.random.fork_rng covering every touched device; isolate any added Python/NumPy randomness as well. Do not recursively initialize the wrapped identity embedding. Verify original baseline parameter equality and RNG restoration before training. The zero residual gate preserves initial effective embeddings; it does not guarantee the subsequent optimization trajectory remains identical.

Deterministic text specification: use only host-permitted public titles/descriptions and training interactions. Never use unavailable reviews, ratings, prices, stores, or item categories. Use catalog metadata only under the host's existing availability policy, without vocabulary decisions based on held-out interactions. Normalize text with Unicode NFKC and casefold. Tokenize with the fixed regex [a-z0-9]+(?:[._/+:-][a-z0-9]+)*|[^\s], retaining repeated tokens and punctuation. This is an explicit default rather than a validated optimum. Build a category-local vocabulary of at most 10,000 entries, reserving PAD=0 and UNK=1; select remaining tokens by descending corpus occurrence count with lexicographic ties. Retain the first 16 title tokens and 64 description tokens, pooling the fields separately. Treat a missing/empty field as zero, distinguish missing text from OOV text, and log coverage, OOV, and truncation rates. Apply these exact transformations in prediction through serialized item-token buffers and tokenizer assets.

Representation: use shared 32-dimensional scratch token embeddings initialized normally with standard deviation 0.02, masked field means, their concatenation, and a bias-free Xavier-initialized projection to the baseline item width. Padding token embeddings remain zero. Define e(i)=ID(i)+tanh(alpha)*stop_gradient(norm(ID(i)))*u(i), where u(i)=projected_text(i)/max(norm(projected_text(i)),1e-3), and alpha is one shared trainable scalar per category initialized to zero. Compute normalization and residual addition in FP32 with autocast disabled, then restore the baseline dtype. Clamp handling means u can have norm below one. Missing text and padding receive exactly zero residual; effective padding rows are exactly zero. Preserve any baseline embedding multiplier at its original location. Deduplicate requested item IDs for efficient differentiable text computation and gather back to their original shapes; never train through detached catalog caches. Register every added parameter in the baseline optimizer using its existing regularization policy.

Gate behavior: at alpha=0, encoder task gradients through this branch are zero, while the gate may receive a nonzero gradient from the random text directions. Encoder learning can begin on a subsequent pass if the gate moves; cancellation can prevent activation. Detaching the ID norm blocks gradients through that scale, not through the encoder. Log alpha, tanh(alpha), gate task gradient and actual update, encoder task-gradient norms and updates, pre-normalization text norms, and lexical-to-ID norm ratios on valid rows. For unit text directions and nonzero ID vectors, the ratio equals abs(tanh(alpha)); under norm clamping it is smaller. Separate None gradients from numerical zeros, measure after mixed-precision unscaling, and distinguish task-gradient updates from weight decay. Persistent inactivity should trigger inspection of optimizer registration, detachment, skipped updates, or per-example cancellation. Large absolute alpha also suppresses the gate derivative. Any nonzero-gate alternative is a separately recorded configuration, not an undocumented repair.

Compatibility and diagnosis: preserve item_emb(ids), baseline-required embedding attributes, effective weight access, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), and host ModelView interfaces. view.model remains the actual trained nn.Module. All history and candidate representations use the same effective embedding. Compute full effective tables in chunks when required. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis); return measured metrics and metric_definitions. Loader batches remain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B x L tensors. Measure ranking errors from actual model scores at valid supervised positions and embedding diagnostics from effective embeddings. Define each metric explicitly and mark unavailable observations unavailable; mean cosine near zero alone does not establish collapse or recommendation diversity. Read the greatest absolute nonpadding position, never count-1, retaining the supplied empty-history policy.

Checkpoint and predictor: serialize architecture configuration, lexical assets, vocabulary/tokenization settings, identity and lexical weights, gate, and backbone together. Update the embedded predictor writer with identical definitions. Each category loads exactly one selected independently trained checkpoint with strict state loading and model.eval(). Begin without an inference cache. If caching is required, build effective vectors in chunks under inference_mode only after loading and fixing device/dtype; invalidate on parameter, state, metadata, device, or dtype changes. Verify loaded-versus-original and cached-versus-uncached scores using documented tolerances and inspect any rank/tie changes. Include left-padded, repeated-item, all-padding, missing-text, and OOV cases. inference_mode alone does not disable dropout.

Experimental matrix and shortcuts: predeclare ID-only and aligned pooled-text configurations using existing host selection rules. Schedule a third matched-shuffle control only if remaining budget permits a complete four-category configuration. For that control, retrain the same text architecture with one fixed item-to-text permutation within train-interaction frequency bins 0-5, 6-20, and at least 21, additionally matching field-presence masks and retained field lengths exactly. Permute paired title/description records together, preserve missing-text masks, retain singleton strata unchanged, and report how many records actually moved. Generate permutations in sorted item order with a local NumPy RNG seed 42; serialize them and use them consistently during training and inference. Restricted shuffling may leave substantial alignment intact. Aligned text outperforming this control supports useful alignment beyond the matched measured properties, but does not prove semantic understanding or eliminate unmeasured confounding. Each configuration has one jointly trained network per category and no prediction fusion. Do not select categories across configurations. Log every attempted configuration, evaluation, failure, selected epoch, and GPU cost; do not treat incomplete configurations as complete comparisons.

Alternative CNN: if pooled text is executable and informative, consider a separately declared whole-field character CNN trained from scratch, preserving punctuation, digits, spaces, and field boundaries. Filters operating across fields' ordered character streams can capture local substring order; global pooling still limits long-range relationships and negation scope. A character encoder applied independently to words followed by unordered word pooling would not solve phrase-order loss. Compare CNN and pooling using identical retained source text, text availability, backbone, objective, sampling, seeds, checkpoint rules, and an explicitly matched total trainable-parameter budget, with actual runtime reported separately. CNN widths, filters, character vocabulary, and padding must be specified before execution; this alternative is not yet a reproducible scheduled configuration. Reordered-phrase, negation, identifier, and dimension perturbations can test representation sensitivity, not numerical understanding or recommendation accuracy. Mean-pooling invariance checks should preserve the exact token multiset and truncation boundaries.

Evaluation and uncertainty: select exclusively using the host's pinned macro validation HR@10 with 200 users/category, 99 unique negative candidates, and evaluation seed 42. Report all category values and their equal-weight macro-average. One changed hit changes category HR by 0.005 and macro HR by 0.00125. If existing host outputs expose paired user hits, report gains/losses and bootstrap paired differences by independently resampling 200 users within each category, averaging categories equally, using 10,000 replicates and a local seed 42; report percentile 95% intervals. If user outcomes are unavailable, omit paired analysis rather than reconstructing hidden evaluator data. Intervals condition on fitted checkpoints and candidates, exclude training-seed/negative-sampling variability, and do not correct adaptive architecture or checkpoint selection. Report descriptive frequency-stratum and text-availability results only from exposed outcomes, including denominators. Fixed sampled HR does not establish full-catalog ranking quality. Keep the native twenty-user full-catalog simulator separate from the selection metric; its failed execution supplies no user-behavior evidence. Treat validation gains as exploratory pending the host's separate held-out evaluation.
idea.pseudocode:
# Integration specification; retain supplied corrected HSTU and training code.
obtain_original_exception_and_restore_executable_baseline()
predeclare_configurations_and_existing_host_selection_rules()
# Required initial comparison: ID_ONLY, ALIGNED_POOLED_TEXT.
# Optional complete matched-shuffle control only within remaining shared budget.
for configuration in declared_configurations:
    for category in FOUR_REQUIRED_CATEGORIES:
        data = supplied_load_and_split(os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], preprocessing_seed=0)
        seed_everything(42)
        model = construct_corrected_HSTU_in_original_initialization_order()
        if configuration != ID_ONLY:
            assets = deterministic_permitted_text_preprocessing(data)
            if configuration == MATCHED_SHUFFLED_TEXT:
                assets = fixed_paired_field_permutation(
                    assets, train_frequency_bins=[0, 5, 20, infinity],
                    match_field_presence_and_retained_lengths=True,
                    local_seed=42)
            with isolated_rng_state():
                lexical = ScratchFieldMeanEncoder(assets, token_dim=32)
                alpha = trainable_scalar(0)
            verify_original_parameters_and_rng_unchanged()
            model.item_emb = SharedEffectiveEmbedding(model.item_emb, lexical, alpha)
        optimizer = baseline_optimizer_with_all_model_parameters(model)
        for epoch in range(min(configured_epochs, 200)):
            model.train()
            for step in range(200):
                _, sequence, positive, negative = family_specific_sample_batch(data)
                features = model.log2feats(sequence)
                loss = unchanged_baseline_loss_using_actual_predict_score(
                    features, positive, negative)
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                loss.backward()
                unscale_gradients_if_baseline_uses_AMP()
                record_gate_and_encoder_task_gradients_at_declared_intervals()
                apply_baseline_clipping_and_optimizer_step()
                record_actual_parameter_updates_and_GPU_cost()
            execute_existing_validation_checkpoint_and_stopping_rules()
            if existing_stopping_rule_fires():
                break
        save_one_selected_checkpoint_with_complete_architecture_and_assets()
    record_complete_configuration_category_and_macro_validation_HR10()
select_complete_configuration_using_existing_host_metric_and_tie_rules()
write_embedded_predictor_with_identical_classes_and_four_category_routes()
verify_strict_load_score_equivalence_padding_and_optional_cache_equivalence()

# Shared effective lookup, used by histories AND every candidate path:
identity = original_lookup(item_ids)
text = lexical(item_ids)  # deduplicate IDs, preserve differentiability
with autocast_disabled():
    direction = text.float() / norm(text.float()).clamp_min(1e-3)
    residual = tanh(alpha.float()) * norm(identity.float()).detach() * direction
    residual = zero_for_missing_text_and_padding(residual)
    effective = zero_padding(identity.float() + residual)
return effective.to(identity.dtype)

# Greatest absolute nonpadding position; preserve baseline empty-history policy.
last = where(sequence != 0, arange(sequence_length), -1).amax(dim=1)
readout = features[nonempty_rows, last[nonempty_rows]]

# Diagnostics retain required class/method/prompt interfaces and metric definitions.
# Paired bootstrap uses only host-exposed stored user outcomes, when available.
# No independently fitted auxiliary scorer, averaging, or score fusion.

originality.positive: The constrained scratch-text adaptation and explicit gate/shortcut controls form a useful controlled HSTU experiment.
originality.negative: Additive content fusion, pooled token encoders, and zero-gated residuals are established methods; the design introduces no demonstrated new modeling principle.

future_potential.positive: Verified alignment-dependent gains could motivate inexpensive lexical sharing and subsequent local-composition experiments without external weights.
future_potential.negative: This is a hypothesis-level rating: missing text, sparse supervision, inactive gates, permutation invariance, and lexical/popularity shortcuts may limit gains, and current diagnostics establish no benefit.

code_difficulty.positive: The pooled-text architectural change is localized to one shared embedding module and preserves the HSTU backbone and baseline training objective.
code_difficulty.negative: RNG preservation, numerical safeguards, gate diagnostics, effective-weight interfaces, reproducible text assets, checkpoint/predictor equivalence, and controlled retraining require moderate integration work; restoring the unknown training failure has unquantified cost.

related_work.title: HSTU-BLaIR (2025)
contributions: Provides precedent for adding projected text representations to HSTU item representations and candidate embeddings.
limitations: Uses pretrained BLaIR representations involving reviews and metadata, unsuitable under this task's restrictions.
Does not establish the effectiveness of scratch-trained pooled text here.

related_work.title: HSTU sampled-softmax reference configuration
contributions: Provides an objective-focused HSTU configuration with sampled negatives, normalized representations, and temperature.
limitations: Its settings are starting points rather than validated optima for the four Amazon categories.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces the HSTU sequential-transduction family and relative positional and temporal attention mechanisms.
limitations: Does not establish that temporal modification improves this fixed benchmark.
Temporal extensions require consistent observed-prefix timestamp availability in training and prediction.

related_work.title: Deep Unordered Composition Rivals Syntactic Methods for Text Classification
contributions: Demonstrates that unordered text composition can perform strongly on classification tasks.
limitations: Does not establish product compatibility, phrase-order sensitivity, numerical reasoning, or recommendation gains.
Mean pooling maps identical token multisets to identical vectors.

related_work.title: Character-Aware Neural Language Models
contributions: Shows how character convolutions can learn shared orthographic and morphological features.
limitations: Does not establish gains for this HSTU benchmark or numerical understanding of product dimensions.
Word-local character encoding followed by unordered word pooling still loses phrase order.

related_work.title: ReZero is All You Need: Fast Convergence at Large Depth
contributions: Introduces zero-initialized trainable residual gates as an optimization mechanism.
limitations: Does not guarantee activation of the proposed normalized lexical branch.
At a zero gate, this branch's encoder receives zero task gradient; gate cancellation and saturation require measurement.

related_work.title: PyTorch automatic differentiation tutorial
contributions: Documents gradient tracking and detachment needed to reason about the residual's gradient paths.
limitations: Provides implementation semantics rather than evidence of recommendation effectiveness.
Parameter updates alone cannot distinguish task learning from optimizer effects such as weight decay.

related_work.title: TASTE
contributions: Reports sequential recommendation benefits from text matching and reduced popularity bias, motivating separation of alignment effects from popularity shortcuts.
limitations: Does not validate scratch lexical-residual HSTU under this task's restrictions.
The proposed matched permutation control is an experimental hypothesis, not a result established by this reference.

related_work.title: On Sampled Metrics for Item Recommendation
contributions: Shows that sampled ranking metrics can produce comparisons inconsistent with full-catalog ranking metrics.
limitations: Does not invalidate the host's prescribed selection metric.
Supports restricting conclusions to the pinned candidate protocol rather than claiming full-catalog gains.

related_work.title: The Reusable Holdout: Preserving Validity in Adaptive Data Analysis
contributions: Establishes the broader statistical problem caused by adaptively reusing holdout observations.
limitations: Ordinary paired bootstrap intervals do not implement its reusable-holdout safeguards.
Predeclaring a small matrix and logging all attempts improve transparency but do not eliminate adaptive selection bias.
